hero.title: Smash Burger
hero.subtitle: The essence of the smash burger: fast, intense, and straightforward. Premium fast food with top-quality ingredients, designed for those who seek flavor without waiting.

sections.title: Estrategia
sections.description: Smash combines premium meat quality with an agile and accessible experience. Its essence is direct and no-nonsense: authentic smash burgers, top-quality ingredients, and speed without losing the artisanal style. It merges the essence of fast food with the gourmet standard, becoming an ideal option for those seeking speed without sacrificing quality. Before our intervention, SMASH needed to define its own identity within the Black Label universe and position itself strategically on social media to attract both local customers and tourists. To achieve this, we developed a modern visual identity and a digital strategy focused on dynamic content, take-away and delivery campaigns, and direct, visually impactful communication.

sections.title: Diseño
sections.description: We created Smash's identity inspired by modern, urban, and visually striking aesthetics. We bet on vibrant colors and intense contrasts that convey energy and freshness, combined with a minimalist aesthetic with grunge touches. The creative reference comes from New York street food and the new generation of fast food, balancing a clean design with pop culture references. To connect with its young audience, stickers, dynamic illustrations, and disruptive graphic elements were incorporated, providing a unique visual identity. Its image conveys dynamism and authenticity, with a palette of black and intense red, bold typography, and worn textures. The art direction emphasizes service speed and flavor explosion with steaming close-up photography, fast framing, and social media animations, while signage and packaging reinforce its message of fast food with a premium essence.

sections.title: Resultado
sections.description: SMASH has established itself as the reference in premium smash burgers in Málaga, achieving a clear and differentiated identity in the market. The brand has gained notoriety in a short time, attracting a loyal audience that values the combination of flavor, speed, and a visually attractive experience. Its positioning in the center of Málaga makes it an ideal destination for tourists and locals, consolidating its reputation within the Black Label universe.
